This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.7/2024 registered at Police Station - Pathariya, District Damoh (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 304-B, 498A, 34 of IPC and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

Applicant is in detention since 10.01.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, deceased was married with co-accused i n the year 03.06.2021.
Thereafter, applicant and co-accused have started harassing the deceased by demanding dowry to the tune of Rs.50,000/-, but family members of deceased did not fulfill the demand, then she was died.
On the basis of said incident, Police registered marg intimation and investigated the matter.
During investigation, Police registered the case against the present applicant and other co-accused persons under the aforesaid Sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
Present applicant is brother-in-law of deceased and he resides separately.

In this regard,
Samagra I.D. Card has been produced.
Present applicant is not the main accused.
Statement of mother and father of the deceased have been recorded in which they have not stated against the applicant.
Charge sheet has been filed.

Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be Rajesh Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104654809/
1 released on bail.

sentences.text: 4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code o f Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that she shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
She shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
In case of breach of any of the aforementioned conditions, the bail granted by this Court shall stand rejected automatically.
7 . This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
